properties.name: Netcraft Social - High risk result
properties.query:
NetcraftSocialResult_Latest
| where IngestedAt > ago(15m)
| where ChangeType == "new"
| extend RiskCategory = tostring(Risk.category)
| where RiskCategory in ("highest", "high")
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    EventId,
    ResultUuid,
    Subject,
    Platform,
    SocialType,
    Username,
    DisplayName,
    Url,
    Verified,
    Risk,
    RiskCategory,
    ChangeType,
    CloudEventType
properties.description:
Identifies newly reported Social results (`ChangeType == "new"`) with `Risk.category` of highest or high.
Uses NetcraftSocialResult_Latest so updates for the same ResultUuid do not re-alert unless
they appear as a new result in the window.

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: New social result {{ResultUuid}} on {{Platform}} reported risk {{RiskCategory}}.
